name: Windborne Cloudwing
printed_text: You can also reveal up to 2 "Windborne" Spells in your hand to activate this effect; Special Summon this card from your hand by shuffling up to 2 cards from your hand into the Deck, including "Windborne" Spells you revealed to activate this effect (if any), and if you do, during the next Standby Phase, add a "Windborne" card from your Deck to your hand for each card you shuffled into the Deck by this effect, except "Windborne Cloudwing", then Set "Windborne" Quick-Play Spells directly from your Deck for each card you revealed to activate this effect. The Set Quick-Play Spell(s) can be activated that turn. When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or effect, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon 1 WIND Synchro Monster, using monsters you control as material, including this card. You can only use each effect of "Windborne Cloudwing" once per turn.
review: Already counts Deck and Extra Deck destinations for delayed search.

name: Janna, Windborne Goddess of Clement Winds
printed_text:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Cannot be targeted by card effects, except your "Windborne" cards, the turn it is Synchro Summoned. If this card is Synchro Summoned using only "Windborne" monsters: You can target up to 2 cards your opponent controls; return them to the hand, then shuffle as many cards from your hand into the Deck and if you do, during the next Standby Phase, add 1 "Windborne" card from your Deck to your hand for each card you shuffled into the Deck by this effect. During the End Phase: you can target 1 "Windborne" Spell in your GY; add that target to your hand during your next Standby Phase. You can only use each effect of "Janna, Windborne Goddess of Clement Winds" once per turn.
review: Delayed search count follows successful Deck returns.

name: Windborne Swiftsurfer

The Set Quick-Play Spell(s) can be activated that turn. When your opponent activates a monster effect, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon 1 WIND Synchro Monster, using monsters you control as material, including this card. review: Already counts Deck and Extra Deck destinations for delayed search.

name: Wyvernal Gathering
printed_text: Take 2 "Wyvernal" monsters from your Deck, then add 1 of them to your hand and send the other to the GY. You can banish this card from your GY and target up to 4 "Wyvernal" or Insect monsters in your GY; shuffle them into the Deck, then draw 1 card for every 2 cards shuffled this way. You can only use 1 "Wyvernal Gathering" per turn, and only once that turn.
review: Already counts Deck and Extra Deck destinations for draw per two.

name: Gladiator Beast Attrocitar
printed_text: If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a "Gladiator Beast" monster: You can target any number of face-up monsters you control; shuffle them into the Deck, then Special Summon that many "Gladiator Beast" monsters from your Deck, except "Gladiator Beast Attrocitar". You can only use the previous effect of "Gladiator Beast Attrocitar" once per turn. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card battled: You can shuffle this card into the Deck; Special Summon 1 "Gladiator Beast" monster from your Deck, except "Gladiator Beast Attrocitar".
review: Recruit count follows successful Deck returns. Special Summon source condition is isolated in the public-engine fixture.

name: Red-Eyes Gearfried, the Iron Knight
printed_text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Red-Eyes" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, also you cannot Special Summon Link Monsters for the rest of this turn. A monster equipped with this card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each. If this card is in the GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 5 other "Red-Eyes" cards on your field, GY, or banishment; shuffle them into the Deck then, if you shuffled "Red-Eyes Black Dragon", you can draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Red-Eyes Gearfried, the Iron Knight" once per turn.
review: Draw is tied to actual Deck arrival of Red-Eyes Black Dragon.

name: Nemleria Big Eepy
printed_text: Shuffle all banished cards into the Decks, then you can Special Summon 1 "Nemleria" monster from your hand or GY for every 10 cards shuffled. You can banish this card from your GY face-down, then show your Extra Deck to your opponent; your opponent banishes 3 cards from your Extra Deck face-down (except "Dreaming Nemleria"), and if they do, negate the effects of 1 card your opponent controls until the End Phase. You can only use each effect of "Nemleria Big Eepy" once per turn.
review: One recruit per ten successful Deck returns.
